seoDescription: Discover cutting-edge solutions with Scytáles that redefine security, convenience, trust, and interoperability.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.body:
The Scytále, by nature, is one of the earliest encryption devices in history used in Ancient Greece to communicate securely during military campaigns.

Scytáles AB aims to utilise the same ethos to develop technology that eradicates fraud and enables accessible and inclusive digital identity for all.

sections.heading: What we do
sections.body: Scytáles is a frontrunner in the ISO international standardization work that is under development— ISO/IEC 18013-5 ISO/IEC JTC1/SC17/WG10, “Personal Identification – ISO-Compliant Driving Licence – Part 5: Mobile Driving Licence Application”, and Part 7, among other ISO/CEN WGs related to our developments and WG memberships.

pills.label: ISO Mobile Driving Licence / Mobile ID
pills.note: The ISO 18013-5 driving licence, held and presented on a phone.

pills.label: EU / Digital ID Wallets
pills.note: The EUDI Wallet and its national deployments across the Union.

pills.label: Open ID technologies
pills.note: OpenID Connect and OpenID4VP for interoperable online presentation.

pills.label: Derived Mobile ID
pills.note: A phone credential derived from an existing high-assurance document.

pills.label: National ID
pills.note: Citizen identity schemes issued and verified at national scale.

pills.label: Travel Documents
pills.note: ePassports and ICAO-compliant credentials, read and validated.

pills.label: Resident Permits
pills.note: Residence credentials issued to the same standards as national ID.

pills.label: Tachographs
pills.note: Driver and company cards for regulated transport.

pills.label: Voter ID
pills.note: Identity assurance for electoral registration and polling.

pills.label: Healthcare ID
pills.note: Credentials for patients and health professionals.

pills.label: Corporate ID
pills.note: Workforce identity for access, signing and authentication.

pills.label: eMoney
pills.note: Identity and consent for regulated payment and wallet services.

pills.label: Digital identification on mobile devices
pills.note: Credentials held in the secure element of the holder's phone.

pills.label: Digital identification stored on servers
pills.note: Server-retrieval credentials, fetched at the moment of presentation.

pills.label: Object ID
pills.note: Identity bound to a thing rather than a person.

pills.label: Authenticity, Traceability & Connectivity
pills.note: Proving what something is, where it came from, and that it is genuine.

pills.label: Biometrics
pills.note: Face and fingerprint matching, on device and at the border.

pills.label: Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
pills.note: Issuing, distributing and revoking the keys everything else trusts.

pills.label: X.509
pills.note: The certificate standard behind document signers and readers.

pills.label: ICAO 9303
pills.note: The machine-readable travel document specification.

pills.label: Public Key Directory (PKD)
pills.note: Cross-border exchange of the certificates used to verify documents.

pills.label: Applied Cryptography
pills.note: Selective disclosure, device binding and the primitives underneath.

pills.label: Credential Service Provider (CSP) solutions
pills.note: Running issuance and lifecycle as a managed service.

sections.heading: Our Story
sections.body:
At the very heart of our Scytáles story is a seasoned team of passionate champions for robust, inclusive, innovative digital/mobile identity solutions that advance sustainable and useful identity ecosystems through global interoperability. We, the founders and key members were united over a strong belief that we could make a significant difference, even sitting in the driving seat for some of this mobile identity transformation at the heart of our digital society.

At the end of the day, it is about building trust in the digital world and generating social and economic benefits to society. It is about making everyone feel secure while in control of their digital footprint. And we take enormous pride and care that in our journey, we create an absolutely fun and fulfilling place to be part of.

Scytáles AB was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, in December 2014.
